title: Meşgul müydün?

characters.MOM: a mother in her sixties with short grey hair and glasses, wearing a lavender cardigan
characters.WOMAN: a young woman of about twenty-eight with long dark hair, wearing a beige trench coat

scenes.text:
Annen seni aradığında neden hep
"Meşgul müydün?" diye başlıyor?
scenes.prompt: At dusk in a quiet living room, {MOM} sits alone in an armchair by a rainy window, a phone resting on the small table beside her, she glances at it.

scenes.text:
Çünkü bütün gün,
seni rahatsız etmeyeceği saati kolladı.
scenes.prompt: In the afternoon, {MOM} stands by the kitchen window looking out at autumn trees, a cup of tea on the counter beside her, soft light.

scenes.text:
Sen işten çıkarken,
o telefona bakıp bekliyordu.
scenes.prompt: On a rainy city street in the evening, {WOMAN} walks quickly out of an office building under an open umbrella, glowing street lamps, people in the background.

scenes.text:
O soru aslında
"Beni biraz dinler misin?" demek.
scenes.prompt: At night, {MOM} sits in her armchair under a warm lamp, looking at the silent phone on the side table with a soft, hopeful expression, rain on the window.

scenes.text:
Bugün o sormadan sen ara.
Bunu annene gönder.
scenes.prompt: At sunset, {MOM} sits by the window laughing with joy, a phone on speaker resting on the table in front of her, warm golden light, autumn leaves outside.

caption:
Annen aradı mı?

O soru aslında bir özlem. 🤍

Bunu annene gönder.
